# projectable expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:projectableExpression`](gmeow-projectableExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/projectableExpression>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A solver-bound input property: the entity being projected through a [`NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md). Used by FnO projection functions to declare their input type; not asserted as canonical data ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Range is open in core; domain slices restrict it.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a projection profile to declare the type of canonical entity the FnO projection function takes as input — the solver-bound hook that names what gets rendered, without asserting the input as stored data.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it as canonical content (it is a solver-layer input declaration, P12) and avoid confusing it with the parameters a profile represents or loses; this names the whole projected expression, not its parameters.

### How to use

- Declare the input type on the profile via [`gmeow:projectableExpression`](gmeow-projectableExpression.md) so the [`gmeow:projectionFunction`](gmeow-projectionFunction.md) knows what it consumes; domain slices restrict its open range to their expression types.

### Examples

- ex:staffProfile [`gmeow:projectableExpression`](gmeow-projectableExpression.md) ex:musicalExpression.
